title: Causal Step math-first, original-theory-interpretation-independent comparison contract v0.2
status: PROPOSED RESEARCH METHOD AMENDMENT; user-originated correction; does not alter qualified IsoGraph semantics or previous source evidence

extends.compatibility: all earlier source contract obligations remain. Existing source records retained as historical; future extractions add this view without silently treating the paper's author-proposed ontology as source-native primitives.

controllingDirections.record: 2026-10-14 researcher message correcting 'generated propagation versus fixed-order propagation' distinction
controllingDirections.requirement: do not use original theory's fixed/dynamic characterization as relevance gate. Mathematical operations on a fixed domain, kernels, recursive compositional identities, observers and explicit rewrites are all eligible, provided precise mathematical domain and lawful operations are stated.

extract source mathematics and induced relationships, allowed operations and implications independently of the author's explanatory physical narrative or terminology; string field/algebra, worldsheet gluing and any other theory may be studied without importing its ontology into primitive Causal Step.
never use numerical physical measurements, assumed units, fitted astronomical phenomena, dimension guesses or scalar closeness as foundational matching criteria.

A_sourceDefinedMathematicalKernel.mathematicalObjects: source-native sets, categories, operator/state spaces, grades, symmetry actions, typing and domains as written in original source
A_sourceDefinedMathematicalKernel.prerequisites: all LOAD-BEARING mathematical assumptions, ambient structures, algebra axioms, metric/Hilbert/geometry/field only if mathematically required by the theorem
A_sourceDefinedMathematicalKernel.operations: total/partial maps, multilinear products, guard predicates, kernels, derivations, boundary/sewing, contraction, rewriting, operators, exact invariants, limits, projections
A_sourceDefinedMathematicalKernel.lawfulness: well-typed expressions; equations and identities under their stated quantifiers, side conditions, and equivalences
A_sourceDefinedMathematicalKernel.sourceVersion: verifiable original paper exact page/section/formula; do not silently transfer page numbering or interpretation across editions

B_authorInterpretationSeparate.claims: author's physical story, ontology, visualization and explanatory labels, archived for source fidelity but never a positive similarity filter
B_authorInterpretationSeparate.warnings: semantic words such as particle, string, photon, field, force, causality, propagation, dimension or entropy are NOT identity certificates
B_authorInterpretationSeparate.provenance: original mathematical work remains attributed to source researchers; user's research direction and agent abstraction separately credited

C_formulationIndependentStructuralAbstra.symbolMap: explicitly defined and typed source symbols to a project-neutral relational/operator language; renamings allowed when mathematically well-formed
C_formulationIndependentStructuralAbstra.candidateRoles: relations and incidence; n-ary interaction; operator on given relations; composition, graded derivation, context, update, identity, gluing, recursion, obstruction and history dependence
C_formulationIndependentStructuralAbstra.sourcePreservation: audit every source law/guard/side condition/quantifier retained or dropped in the abstraction
C_formulationIndependentStructuralAbstra.noForcedReinterpretation: do not force a fixed-graph functional into a rewrite or call a string-field product a Causal Step event merely because arity resembles a hyperedge
C_formulationIndependentStructuralAbstra.noEarlyExclusion: no original-discipline domain, fixed-input operator, higher-level science or fundamental theory is categorically disfavored as MATH; tentative generative-depth hypothesis can guide scheduling of PHYSICAL hypotheses but cannot veto a mathematical match

D_scopedComparisons.scopeAndEquivalence: name exact subset, sign/grade conventions, admissible operation set, renaming equivalence, what reversibility/reconstruction is required, source and target assumptions
D_scopedComparisons.forward: for selected operations f, compare F(f_source(inputs)) to f_target(F(inputs)) and state when defined
D_scopedComparisons.backward: prove reconstruction/equivalence only for the claimed level; do not infer full process bisimulation from an n-ary algebraic shape or static observer
D_scopedComparisons.negativeCases: record nonmaps, information loss, hidden source premises, failed event identity and third-event history/coherence; retain T4 83 state-indexed independence and 660 triple-composition obstructions
D_scopedComparisons.uncertainty: candidate mathematical shared shape != proved isomorphism != common physical substrate

researchExecution: Always search for latent mathematical forms irrespective of papers' named disciplines, original ontology or fixed/dynamic framing.
Read original papers and audit exact formulas, types, prerequisites, identities and negative conditions.
Create a source-faithful model before a neutral symbolic encoding; store both and a map between them.
Inspect alternative factorizations and substructure maps; never identify representation with ontology.
Preserve source citations, paper mathematical definitions and author's claimed theorems without adopting their physical story.
Keep qualified Core/Woit/Lisi/main and original Causal Step generator immutable; C1-C4 remain open; no broad new native physics simulation.
notAClaim: This contract does NOT claim that string theory or any other source math implies a fundamental graph, a causal partial order, bit-level rewriting or established emergent physical law.
